title: Elite Crawl: tuning
notes: Only meaningful with the elite-crawl mod (its code reads this block in free space; the clean ROM has 0xFF here). One row; every field is a u16 and 0xFFFF (or out of range) means the default given in the field notes. Enemy level = enemy_base_level + (floor-1) x enemy_levels_per_10_floors / 10 (+ boss_level_bonus) +-1.
label: Tuning

fields.name: start_level
fields.notes: Your team's level at the start of a run (1-100); default 60

fields.name: enemy_levels_per_10_floors
fields.notes: Enemy levels gained every 10 floors; default 6

fields.name: boss_every
fields.notes: A boss every N floors (0 = never); default 5

fields.name: boss_level_bonus
fields.notes: Extra levels for boss Pokémon; default 3

fields.name: iv_per_10_floors
fields.notes: Enemy IVs gained every 10 floors (max 31); default 5

fields.name: tier_floors
fields.notes: Floor where the strongest trainers are reached (pools slide from weak to strong); default 50

fields.name: legend_floor
fields.notes: First floor where enemies may field legendaries; default 20

fields.name: legend_chance
fields.notes: % chance per random enemy slot to be legendary (from legend_floor); default 5

fields.name: trade_legend_floor
fields.notes: First floor where the trader may offer a legendary; default 10

fields.name: trade_legend_chance
fields.notes: % chance that a trade offer is legendary; default 10

fields.name: held_item_floor
fields.notes: First floor where enemies get random held items; default 10

fields.name: held_item_chance
fields.notes: % chance per enemy Pokémon to get a random held item; default 30

fields.name: start_money
fields.notes: Money at the start of a run; default 3000

fields.name: money_per_floor
fields.notes: Bonus money per win = this x floor number; default 200

fields.name: rare_candies
fields.notes: Rare Candies from the TRAINING reward; default 3

fields.name: item_evo_level
fields.notes: Level at which stone/trade/item evolutions are applied to generated Pokémon; default 40
